digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with Russia backs India’s candidature for UNSC permanent seat. Europe & Russia carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर दुनिया की अगुवाई है, क्यों यूपी में हो रही है मूसलाधार बारिश? जानिए कब तक होगी बरसात मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Russia backs India’s candidature for UNSC permanent seat
articles.summary: “We are in favour of broadening the representation of Asia, Africa, and Latin America. We support Brazil's and India's candidatures for a permanent seat, and at the same time, I wish to emphasise this: we must satisfy the interests of the African continent,” Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov said. Russia backs India’s candidature for UNSC permanent seat.

articles.title: Russia's top diplomat rejects German calls to ease off its 'dangerous' escalation toward it
articles.summary: Does Berlin understand what this could lead to? Didn't they not learn the lessons of World War II? Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov asked in his speech at the UN General Assembly's annual gathering of world leaders Russia's top diplomat rejects German calls to ease off its 'dangerous' escalation toward it.

articles.title: US challenges China on secret nuclear tests as arms race looms
articles.summary: A mounting standoff over allegations of covert Chinese nuclear testing and rapid arsenal expansion has collided with an intensifying domestic debate within the US over whether it must abandon its decades-long test moratorium.

articles.title: Relentless rainfall triggers floods, landslips across Nepal
articles.summary: In Rupandehi district, a part of Lumbini province, floodwaters from the Tinau River swept away six houses along the riverbank in Butwal on Saturday night as the river rose above its danger level, the Kathmandu Post newspaper reported. Relentless rainfall triggers floods, landslips across Nepal.

articles.title: Cardiff City footballer Perry Ng receives Singapore citizenship, awaits FIFA clearance to represent
articles.summary: "Singapore has always been part of my family’s story, and over the years, it has become home to me too. I’m grateful for everyone who has supported me on this journey," says the 30-year-old defender. Cardiff City footballer Perry Ng receives Singapore citizenship, awaits FIFA clearance to represent.

articles.title: Ireland players agree to play Israel fixtures, plan black armbands
articles.summary: David Courell, the CEO of the Football Association of Ireland, said at a long-delayed press conference earlier that an unnamed player's “discomfort with fulfilling this fixture” had caused deliberations for the rest of the squad Ireland players agree to play Israel fixtures, plan black armbands.

articles.title: US strikes on Ecuadorian fishing boats raise humanitarian concerns but Trump admin not wavering
articles.summary: Attorney says fishers ‘losing their livelihoods’, but Marco Rubio maintains US still willing to ‘blow up ships if need be’While the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio, was being decorated in Quito by Ecuador’s president for “helping to promote peace in the region”, 10 Ecuadorian fishers whose boat had been blown up by US forces were adrift in the eastern Pacific.

articles.title: Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’
articles.summary: Canada’s Foreign Minister Anita Anand warned the UN General Assembly on Saturday that the international order has entered an era of profound disruption, calling for stronger multilateral cooperation and new partnerships as major powers increasingly turn away from global economic integration. Canada urges stronger partnerships as global order faces ‘rupture’.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia warns Gulf security inseparable from global stability amid regional tensions
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia’s Foreign Minister warned on Saturday that escalating threats across the Middle East risked international peace, energy security and global trade, calling for stronger international cooperation to protect Gulf States and vital shipping routes. Saudi Arabia warns Gulf security inseparable from global stability amid regional tensions.

articles.title: Cuba warns against ‘law of the jungle’ as Foreign Minister denounces US pressure
articles.summary: Cuba’s Foreign Minister warned the UN General Assembly on Saturday that escalating military and economic pressure in Latin America and the Caribbean was threatening international law, while accusing the United States of intensifying a decades-long campaign to isolate and weaken his country. Cuba warns against ‘law of the jungle’ as Foreign Minister denounces US pressure.

articles.title: Lavrov issues call for new Eurasian ‘security architecture’
articles.summary: Russia's Foreign Minister, Sergey Lavrov, accused Western countries of destabilising the world through “force and double standards” in his address to the UN General Assembly on Saturday, vowing that Moscow's “special military operation” in Ukraine would be “carried through to the end.” Lavrov issues call for new Eurasian ‘security architecture’.

articles.title: Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age
articles.summary: Countries adopted on Saturday a new global blueprint for tackling rapidly evolving forms of crime on Saturday, as the UN’s largest gathering on crime prevention and criminal justice opened in Abu Dhabi with a call for stronger international cooperation. Countries adopt global blueprint to tackle fast-evolving crime in digital age. articles.title: UN General Assembly debate Day 4
articles.summary: Small island leaders at the United Nations General Assembly on 26 September demanded climate justice, stronger ocean protection and increased solidarity. They warned that rising seas are already reshaping national borders and that distant conflicts are producing tangible impacts on their coasts. From the Caribbean to the Pacific, leaders from small island States demanded climate justice, ocean protection and greater solidarity at the UN General Assembly on Friday.

articles.title: Poland Offers Financial Incentives To US As Talks On Military Base Advance, Minister Tells RFE/RL
articles.summary: Poland is offering to pay $15,000 a year for every US soldier stationed on its territory and cover infrastructure costs as Warsaw and Washington move closer to agreeing on establishing a permanent American military base. Poland Offers Financial Incentives To US As Talks On Military Base Advance, Minister Tells RFE/RL.

articles.title: Ukrainian Soldiers Brave Russian Drones On Trek To Frontline Settlements
articles.summary: Ukrainian troops trek nearly 20 kilometers to reach Bilozerske in the embattled Donetsk region. Russian drone and aerial attacks have laid waste to the city that used to house 15,000 inhabitants. Speaking with RFE/RL, one soldier said that "everything is bad" near Dobropillia. articles.summary: While the US president hailed the visit as ‘great’, almost nothing of substance was achieved, which was a win for XiKey takeaways from the Trump-Xi summit in WashingtonIf the Beijing meeting between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in May was the “stalemate summit”, the second round of talks between the presidents of the US and China this week seemed to give up entirely on the idea of breakthroughs.

articles.title: Tuvalu urges decisive global action as rising seas threaten its future
articles.summary: Climate change remains the greatest existential threat to Tuvalu, Prime Minister Feleti Teo told the UN General Assembly on Friday, warning that the pace and scale of international action are still falling far short of what vulnerable island nations need. Tuvalu urges decisive global action as rising seas threaten its future.

articles.title: West Bank demolitions accelerate, urgent support for Sudan, Haiti diplacement, AI hub to boost
articles.summary: The situation in the occupied West Bank continues to deteriorate, the UN human rights office has said, pointing to the “mass destruction” of Palestinian villages and forcible transfer of residents in Msafer Yatta, South Hebron Hills. West Bank demolitions accelerate, urgent support for Sudan, Haiti diplacement, AI hub to boost.

articles.title: As Deadline Looms, Ex-US Marine Desperately Seeks Brother At Afghan Refugee Camp In Qatar
articles.summary: A former US Marine spent days in Doha trying to meet his brother at an Afghan refugee camp that will close on 30 September. The camp houses 2,000 refugees whose planned transfer to the United States was halted by a presidential executive order. The inmates face an uncertain future. A former US Marine has spent days trying to see his brother at a camp in Qatar holding Afghan refugees in limbo after plans to bring them to the United States were blocked by a presidential executive order.

articles.title: Deadly New Strikes In Russia's War On Ukraine As Spillover Concerns Mount
articles.summary: Russia kept up its pattern of relentless attacks on Kyiv, killing a 14-year-old boy and injuring seven other people in a drone strike on an apartment building in the capital on September 25, Ukrainian authorities said. Deadly New Strikes In Russia's War On Ukraine As Spillover Concerns Mount.
